author: Bellular News
description:
Sony bought Haven to make Fairgames. Now the game is dead, but the studio gets to stay. Why did Haven survive when Bluepoint didn’t? The answer has as much to do with Wolverine, GTA VI and what Sony can afford as it does with a heist shooter that never shipped.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!

00:54 Why the Heist Shooter Fell Apart
03:25 Why Haven Gets to Stay
05:50 Why Sony Calls Wolverine a Success
08:01 What GTA VI Buys PlayStation
